item.text: The service layer is the right enforcement point: it preserves the existing scope, lookup, and permission failures before the lock error, and prevents writes before repository mutations or event publication. I’ve identified the member initiated write services, including invitation acceptance (which has no actor permission check, so token validity and expiration must remain first).

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('src/server/services')
files={
'issue-service.ts':['assertCan(actor, \"issue:create\", projectResource(project));','assertCan(actor, \"issue:update\", issueResource(before));','assertCan(actor, \"issue:assign\", issueResource(before));','assertCan(actor, \"issue:archive\", issueResource(issue));'],
'project-service.ts':['assertCan(actor, \"project:create\", orgResource(input.orgId));','assertCan(actor, \"project:update\", projectResource(project));','assertCan(actor, \"project:archive\", projectResource(project));'],
'comment-service.ts':['assertCan(actor, \"comment:create\", issueResource(issue));','assertCan(actor, \"comment:update\", commentResource(comment));','assertCan(actor, \"comment:delete\", commentResource(comment));'],
'attachment-service.ts':['assertCan(actor, \"issue:update\", issueResource(issue));'],
'member-service.ts':['assertCan(actor, \"member:update_role\", memberResource(member));','assertCan(actor, \"member:remove\", memberResource(member));'],
'label-service.ts':['assertCan(actor, \"project:update\", orgResource(input.orgId));','assertCan(actor, \"project:archive\", orgResource(orgId));'],
'webhook-service.ts':['assertCan(actor, \"webhook:manage\", webhookResource(input.orgId, null));','assertCan(actor, \"webhook:manage\", webhookResource(input.orgId, input.webhookId));'],
'feature-flag-service.ts':['assertCan(actor, \"org:manage_flags\", orgResource(input.orgId));'],
'organization-service.ts':['assertCan(actor, \"org:update\", orgResource(input.orgId));'],
}
for name, needles in files.items():
 p=base/name
 s=p.read_text()
 if 'assertWorkspaceWritable' not in s:
  # Insert import near first local service import, consistently
  marker='import { assertCan }'
  if marker in s: s=s.replace(marker,'import { assertWorkspaceWritable } from \"@/server/services/billing-service\";\\n'+marker,1)
  else: raise Exception('no import marker '+name)
 for needle in needles:
  if needle not in s: continue
  s=s.replace(needle,needle+'\\n  await assertWorkspaceWritable('+('orgId' if 'orgId' in needle and 'orgResource(orgId)' in needle else ('input.orgId' if 'input.orgId' in needle or 'input.orgId' not in needle else ''))+');',1)
 p.write_text(s)
PY
"
